Quality gates and engine constants

Nine checks run on every pipeline execution. Their job is not to make the numbers better - it is to stop an indefensible number being published quietly. Every finding carries a review_action saying what a human should do next; an irregularity with no review action cannot be actioned. See the full explanation.

checkhow it runswhat it catches
check_zero_projectionregisteredPlayers with a salary but no projected points cannot be ranked meaningfully.
check_duplicate_idsregistered
check_implausible_valuesregisteredRange checks against physically impossible values.
check_stale_provenanceregisteredFlag any input whose recorded fetch time is older than ``STALE_AFTER_HOURS``.
check_endpoint_failuresregisteredOne finding per distinct failing URL, with the retry count stated.
check_ownership_normalisationregisteredpOWN across a slate should sum to roughly 1.0 (100%).
check_scoring_coverageregisteredAny projected stat with no scoring coefficient is invisible to FPTS.
check_representation_double_countregisteredFail loudly if the scoring table counts the same production twice.
check_cross_source_identitycalled explicitlyFlag entities present in one source but absent from the official one.
